# Gateway Services

> A licensed Saudi company helping Arabic and English-speaking students register at Malaysian universities and English language centers.

Gateway Services (بوابتك إلى ماليزيا) is a Saudi-registered educational consultancy that assists students — primarily from Arabic-speaking countries — with admission, visa, and settlement procedures for studying in Malaysia. All core services are provided free of charge to students.

## Audience

- Arabic-speaking students (primary) seeking universities or English language institutes in Malaysia
- English-speaking international students exploring Malaysian higher education
- Parents and guardians researching study-abroad options

## Public pages

- [Home](https://gatewayservicess.com/): Overview of services, featured institutions, and study packages
- [About Us](https://gatewayservicess.com/about): Company background, mission, and why students choose Gateway Services
- [Institutions](https://gatewayservicess.com/institutions): Directory of partnered Malaysian universities and English language centers
- [Announcements](https://gatewayservicess.com/announcements): Latest news, promotions, and program updates
- [Terms & Conditions](https://gatewayservicess.com/terms): Service terms, refund policy, and legal notices
